chunks: And Safwan narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, who said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:
"Game is not to be slaughtered in the Haram, even if it was hunted in the Hil."

key_terms.الصَّيْدُ: game animal that has been hunted
key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the Sacred Sanctuary, where special prohibitions apply
key_terms.الْحِلِّ: the area outside the sacred sanctuary where ordinary restrictions do not apply

ai.seo_question: Can hunted game be slaughtered inside the Haram if it was caught outside it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the sanctity of the Haram: hunted game may not be slaughtered within its bounds. The prohibition remains even when the animal was caught outside the sanctuary, showing the special inviolability of the Haram in fiqh.
